summary: [Jobber] events: Webhooks: subscribe with topics (CLIENT_CREATE/UPDATE, JOB_UPDATE, INVOICE_UPDATE/PAID, VISIT_COMPLETE/UPDATE). Payload {data:{webHookEvent:{topic, appId, accountId, itemId, occurredAt}}}. At-least-once: retries on non-200; always return 200 (silent 200 for unknown tenants prevents retry storms). Handler: HMAC-verify (x-jobber-hmac-sha256 = base64 HMAC-SHA256(raw body, client_secret)), resolve itemId -> client -> phones, act. Polling fallback: GraphQL connections with first/after cursors + filters.
